Product check / Your shopping
Paste your shopping list. See what you'd keep a year.
Paste a list or the text of a receipt. We match each brand to a cheaper product that does the same job, from stores that sell where you live, and add up what switching keeps. When we can't tell which product a line means, we ask.
SameButCheaper
We find cheaper products that do the same job as the brand names, show what differs and link the proof. No brand pays to be listed or ranked.
No link on this site earns us anything today. Read our disclosure.
